rootCause.evidence: Original NBA-01B fetched and normalized all 174 historical responses in memory, then upserted the full sports_odds_snapshots set in one Supabase REST request after event and mapping writes. Supabase/Cloudflare returned HTTP 520 on that giant odds upsert; no checkpoint had been written before the DB failure.
rootCause.responseDurabilityDefect: Provider response was not persisted durably before DB persistence.
